Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?

02:59 PM

Absolutely, for what you described, the two best everyday options are Diana Relaxed Straight and Catherine Boyfriend 😊

Diana Relaxed Straight is better if you want a cleaner, more versatile everyday jean. It has a relaxed fit through the hip and thigh with a straight leg, so it is easy to dress up or down.

Catherine Boyfriend is better if comfort is your top priority and you like a more casual, looser look. It has a roomier fit with a slightly tapered ankle, so it feels more laid back.

For everyday use, good quality, and value for money, I would point you to Diana Relaxed Straight as the better overall match.
